subject: MAP kickoff: Redwood MAP draft & timeline options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Sullivan <ava.sullivan@summitcloud.io>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 17:25:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: Redwood MAP draft & timeline options

Hi Ava —

Thanks again for the demo and the productive discovery earlier today. As promised, I’ve attached an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft (Redwood_MAP_draft_SummitCloud_v1.xlsx) outlining the proposed milestones, owners, dependencies, and two timeline options. High level: 

- Target close: Option A (standard): 2026-09-30 (10-week cadence) — recommended for typical enterprise procurement cycles.
- Option B (accelerated): 2026-08-15 (4-week accelerated path) — requires fast procurement sign-off, SOC2 evidence review, and a prioritized technical uplift window.

Key milestones in the draft:
1) Technical scoping & integration requirements — owner: Redwood (Aditya Rao), collaborator: SummitCloud Eng
2) Security & compliance review (SOC2 evidence + questionnaire) — owner: SummitCloud Security
3) Procurement & contract review — owner: SummitCloud Procurement
4) Pilot setup & validation (3–5 day pilot) — owner: SummitCloud Product, Redwood Delivery
5) Final sign-off & go-live

Action items for you:
- Confirm the internal SummitCloud stakeholders who should be listed as milestone owners (security, procurement, engineering, product).
- Which timeline do you prefer (Option A: 2026-09-30 or Option B: 2026-08-15)?
- Any hard constraints we should bake into the MAP (budget window, blackout dates, audit schedule)?

Proposed next step: schedule a 30–45 minute MAP kickoff to walk through the draft and lock owners/timing. I’m available tomorrow (Tue) 2–5pm PT and Wednesday 10am–3pm PT. If there’s a preferred time, I’ll send a calendar invite and include Aditya for the technical scoping items.

I also linked the security questionnaire and a short SOC2 evidence checklist in the attached PDF to make the review process easier.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning stakeholders and getting the MAP locked in.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0189

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_draft_SummitCloud_v1.xlsx, SOC2_evidence_request.pdf

Thanks Marissa —

Appreciate the clear MAP draft. Quick notes from our side after an internal sync:
- Primary stakeholders to include: Tom Reddick (VP Engineering), Priya Shah (Head of Security), Will Gomez (Procurement lead), and myself for product validation.
- Procurement needs to see a completed SOC2 evidence package and a redline-ready contract before QBR approval.
- Preferred target close: end of Q3 (2026-09-30). We can consider the accelerated option only if SOC2 evidence and legal review complete earlier.

I can do Wed 21 Jul at 2:00pm PT for the MAP kickoff — I’ll invite Tom and Priya to the meeting. If you can include Aditya for the technical scoping that’d be great.

On dependencies: please add a procurement milestone (contract redline & PO issuance) and a security milestone for a SOC2 evidence handoff. Also note we have a planned maintenance window Aug 10–12 that might affect pilot timing.

Looking forward to the kick-off.

Best,
Ava Sullivan
Senior Product Manager | SummitCloud
ava.sullivan@summitcloud.io
(650) 555-0142
